pages.text: The Commanding Horn allows you to change movement stances of your servants, that are within 4 blocks from you, and comes with multiple modes that can be changed by shift-right clicking while holding it.
On None mode, the horn makes the servants go between Standing By and Following. On others it will cause all servant nearby to enter the mode the horn is set to.

You can also right click on a block to have them move towards it, unless the servants are guarding and the horn is not in Guard mode. However, servants that are already commanded or part of a $(l:crafts/grimoire_of_grounding)Grimoire of Grounding$() are unaffected by the horn.
